summary: Execute a KPI's bound formula against its sources and return the scalar value plus a trimmed KPI summary.

params.name: date_range_start
params.doc: GA4 relative ('30daysAgo') or ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Only affects time-sensitive inputs (GA4); BigQuery inputs apply their own filters.

returns: { value: float|null, mode:'push_down'|'pull_up'|null, expression, inputs:{key:float}, warnings:[str], error:str|null, kpi:{slug,name,unit,format,direction,target} } (shape from compute_kpi_by_slug + attached kpi summary)

summary: Returns the project's Business Context markdown doc (industry, audience, rules). No params.
returns: { scope: 'project', project, content: str, has_content: bool, note } | {error,error_type,message}

summary: Full structured spec for one KPI by case-insensitive slug (identity, definition, expression, bound inputs, quality metadata).

params.name: slug
params.doc: Case-insensitive KPI slug (matched via lower(slug)==lower(arg)). Required.

summary: Concise KPI catalog for the active project (slug, name, aliases, status, category, unit, direction, is_ready, short_description) filtered by lifecycle status.

params.name: status
params.doc: Lifecycle status filter; lowercased+stripped. 'all' skips the status WHERE clause.
